text:
Tara Iqbal: quick check on the notify-routing preview in SLO editor. I tried a compact single-line preview when you hover the "Preview routes" icon. fig: https://www.figma.com/file/example/notify-routing-compact Evan Cho: saw it. compact is great for density but the route badges collapse into initials at narrow widths and you lose channel context. :thinking_face: Miguel Santos: agree. suggestion: show first badge full, then +N overflow. don't abbreviate names unless space < 320px. also add a tooltip with full name on hover/focus. Priya Desai: a11y note: hover-only previews exclude keyboard users. make the preview toggleable with a button (aria-expanded) and ensure the content is role=region with aria-label="Notification routing preview". Tara Iqbal: good call. I also noticed the message template in the preview has no token highlights. would be nice to render {{service}} and {{env}} differently so users can scan where fields map. Evan Cho: token highlighting should not rely on color alone. add monospace + bordered pill for tokens and include an accessible label like "token: service" for screen readers. Miguel Santos: spacing nit: when the preview expands inline it pushes the SLO name down. prefer an overlay anchored to the icon to avoid layout reflow during incident triage. Overlay should reposition on viewport boundaries. Priya Desai: keyboard flow: button opens overlay, focus moves to first interactive element, Esc closes and returns focus to the button. announce open/close via aria-live polite. Also ensure overlay is reachable by screen reader even if it's visually off-screen on small devices. Tara Iqbal: microcopy: current preview header "Routes" -> change to "Notification routing" for clarity. Also change badge tooltip from "channel" to "Channel: PagerDuty (primary)" so it reads naturally when voiced. Evan Cho: color contrast: green used for primary route has 3.1:1 against white. bump to darker green (#006F4C) and add icon shapes for non-color state. Miguel Santos: performance: overlay fetches routing info on open. debounce rapid open/close to 150ms and cache results per-rule for 30s to avoid thundering on lists. Priya Desai: accessibility sample snippet idea: ```

To: PagerDuty (primary), #alerts (slack)

``` Tara Iqbal: action items: Evan - update palette + token styles; Miguel - overlay anchor + caching; Priya - aria copy + keyboard flow; I'll update figma and add the new samples. UXBot: can you create the ticket? :slightly_smiling_face: UXBot: ticket created: design/1979001234 "notify-routing: compact preview -> overlay + a11y". ETA PR: 1979001302. https://tickets.internal/1979001234 Evan Cho: will land color/token styles after lunch. Tara Iqbal: thanks team aiming to ship this in the next patch.
